text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdelatif Filali tells U.N. General Assembly of wish to break deadlock over referendum in Western Sahara.
- King Hassan meets envoy of Kuwait's Emir Sheik Jaber al-Ahmed al-Sabah.
- King Hassan tells French journalists that foreign investors are welcome.
- Tourism crisis persistent even in traditionally most- visited cities.
- Morocco and United Nations centre to cooperate over inclusion of human rights in education.
- Prime Minister Filali invites Spain to talks over enclaves of Ceuta and Mellila occupied since the 16th century.
